card.title: 110. PANZERGRENADIER
card.text: Your ground units with 4 or more attack deal +3 damage.
card.flavorText: The 110th Panzergrenadier Regiment was part of the 11th Panzer-Division of the German Wehrmacht during WWII. The division was formed in August 1940 and saw its first action during the Invasion of Yugoslavia in 1941, where it participated in the capture of Belgrade, the capital and largest city of Serbia. The 11th Division was then sent to the Eastern Front where it took part in the Battle of Kiev and the Battle of Moscow as part of the Army Group South. Finally their advance came to a halt and during the Soviet counter-offensive in December 1941 the division had to retreat and fought in defensive operations. In June 1942 the 11th Panzer Division was involved in Case Blue, a failed German strategic offensive with the objective of capturing the oil fields of Baku (Azerbaijan SSR), Grozny and Maikop. After this, the division participated in the failed relief attempt at Stalingrad and defended Rostov, helping German forces retreat from the Caucasus. In July 1943 the division fought in the Battle of Kursk and the defensive operations during the following German retreat. After being trapped in the Korsun-Cherkassy Pocket in February 1944, the division was almost entirely destroyed during its breakout from the pocket. The remains of the division were then sent to France where they fought with Army Group G against the Allied invasion of southern France. The survivors finally surrendered to the US forces in Czechoslovakia in 1945.
